story.title: DeepSeek V4 API priced 97% below OpenAI's GPT-5.5, threatening global AI pricing norms
story.summary: Chinese AI firm DeepSeek has slashed API pricing for its new V4 model to as low as $0.14 per million input tokens for cached requests, a level the company says is 97% cheaper than OpenAI's GPT-5.5. DeepSeek also reduced prices for cache-hit inputs to one-tenth of previous levels, a move that could force rival AI providers to respond with their own cuts. The pricing announcement follows the release of DeepSeek V4's preview, which features longer context windows and open-source weights.
